Fallback mode for pneumothorax segmentation.
Target: pneumothorax
Hard requirements:
- Exact input resolution
- ROI white (#FFFFFF), background black (#000000)
- No gray values, no antialiasing, no text/overlay
Clinical rule: segment pleural air only.
Exclusions: normal lung, mediastinum/heart, osseous structures, skin folds, tubes/lines, and external annotations.
Low-contrast constraint: avoid scattered micro-islands; prefer one contiguous ROI when clinically plausible.
Minimum ROI area fraction: 0.0
Maximum ROI area fraction: 0.8
Minimum connected components: 1
Maximum connected components: 1024
Tool mode: closed. Do not rely on external retrieval tools.
NanoBanana image-generation mode: return one generated image only, with no markdown, JSON, or explanatory text.
